name: Sentinelles grippe France
note: Réseau Sentinelles (Inserm, Sorbonne Université): weekly incidence per 100 000 of influenza-like illness in France since 1984. thresholdValue is a watch threshold chosen here, not the network's epidemic threshold, which it publishes each season in its bulletin.

name: Essais vaccins tuberculose
note: ClinicalTrials.gov: every registered study of a tuberculosis vaccine and its status. A status that changes (recruiting, completed, terminated) is a variation.

name: Relevés d'une sonde (exemple)
note: The generic format any probe or instrument export can take: an array of snapshots, oldest first. Replace the path with your own export.
